items.prompt: קַח נַפְשִׁי כִּי לֹא־טוֹב אָנֹכִי מֵאֲבֹתָי
items.answer: Take away my life, for I am not better than my fathers.

items.prompt: מַה־מָּתוֹק מִדְּבַשׁ וּמֶה עַז מֵאֲרִי
items.answer: What is sweeter than honey? and what is stronger than a lion?

items.prompt: אֹהֵב יהוה שַׁעֲרֵי צִיּוֹן מִכֹּל מִשְׁכְּנוֹת יַעֲקֹב
items.answer: Yahweh loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwelling-places of Jacob.

items.prompt: טוֹב יוֹם הַמָּוֶת מִיּוֹם הִוָּלְדוֹ
items.answer: The day of death is better than the day of one's birth.

items.prompt: וְאֵין אִישׁ מִבְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל טוֹב מִמֶּנּוּ מִשִּׁכְמוֹ וָמַעְלָה גָּבֹהַּ מִכָּל־הָעָם
items.answer: There was no man of the Israelites goodlier than he: from his shoulders and upward he was taller than any of the people.

items.prompt: הַיָּפָה בַּנָּשִׁים
items.answer: O thou fairest among women!

items.prompt: הִנֵּה שְׁמֹעַ מִזֶּבַח טוֹב לְהַקְשִׁיב מֵחֵלֶב אֵילִים
items.answer: Behold, obedience is better than sacrifice, and to hearken than the fat of rams.

items.prompt: כַּאֲשֶׁר שִׁכְּלָה נָשִׁים חַרְבֶּךָ כֵּן־תִּשְׁכַּל מִנָּשִׁים אִמֶּךָ
items.answer: As thy sword has bereaved women, so shall thy mother be the most bereaved of women.

items.prompt: וְנִבְחַר מָוֶת מֵחַיִּים לְכֹל הַנִּשְׁאָרִים מִן־הַמִּשְׁפָּחָה הָרָעָה הַזֹּאת
items.answer: And death shall be chosen rather than life by all that are left of this evil family.
items.note: verify against scan (Jer. 8:3 reads לְכֹל הַשְּׁאֵרִית הַנִּשְׁאָרִים)

items.prompt: ועתה יהוה קח־נא את־נפשי ממני כי טוב מותי מחיי
items.answer: And now, O Yahweh, take away my life, I pray thee, from me; for it is better for me to die than to live.

data.pointed: וְעַתָּה יְהוָה קַח־נָא אֶת־נַפְשִׁי מִמֶּנִּי כִּי טוֹב מוֹתִי מֵחַיָּי

items.prompt: אעשה אותך לגוי־עצום ורב ממנו
items.answer: I will make of thee a nation more powerful and numerous than it.

items.prompt: And the serpent was more cunning than all the beasts (sing.) of the field which God had made.
items.answer: וַיְהִי הַנָּחָשׁ עָרוּם מִכֹּל חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה אֱלֹהִים

items.prompt: He has slain men more righteous than he.
items.answer: הָרַג צַדִּיקִים מִמֶּנּוּ

items.prompt: Thou art wiser than Daniel.
items.answer: חָכָם אַתָּה מִדָּנִיֵּאל

items.prompt: A living dog is better than a dead lion.
items.answer: טוֹב הַכֶּלֶב הַחַי מִן־הָאַרְיֵה הַמֵּת

items.prompt: And that man was greater than all the children of (the) East.
items.answer: וַיְהִי הָאִישׁ הַהוּא גָּדוֹל מִכָּל־בְּנֵי קֶדֶם

items.prompt: And he loved Joseph more than all his sons, for a son of old age (was) he to him.
items.answer: וַיֶּאֱהַב אֶת־יוֹסֵף מִכָּל־בָּנָיו כִּי־בֶן־זְקֻנִים הוּא לוֹ

items.prompt: And he lifted up his eyes and saw his brother, the son of his mother, and he said, Is this your youngest brother, whom ye mentioned (said) to me?
items.answer: וַיִּשָּׂא אֶת־עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא אֶת־אָחִיו בֶּן־אִמּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר הֲזֶה אֲחִיכֶם הַקָּטֹן אֲשֶׁר אֲמַרְתֶּם אֵלָי

items.prompt: And he had two daughters, and the younger was fairer than the elder.
items.answer: וְלוֹ שְׁתֵּי בָנוֹת וַתְּהִי הַקְּטַנָּה יָפָה מִן־הַגְּדוֹלָה

items.prompt: The greatest (men) of the city
items.answer: גְּדוֹלֵי הָעִיר

items.prompt: There was not left to him except the youngest of his sons.
items.answer: לֹא נִשְׁאַר־לוֹ כִּי אִם קְטַן בָּנָיו

items.prompt: And their gain was too much for dwelling together, and the land was not able to bear them.
items.answer: וַיְהִי רְכוּשָׁם רָב מִשֶּׁבֶת יַחְדָּו וְלֹא יָכְלָה הָאָרֶץ לָשֵׂאת אֹתָם
